Overview

Faridabad is a city in Haryana with a population of 1,500,000. A major industrial city in Haryana and part of the Delhi NCR, known for its manufacturing and automotive industries. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
